__comment: Overrides vanilla's leather equipment asset to give leather HORSE armour three dyeable zones. WARNING: this one file serves the player's leather armour as well - humanoid, humanoid_baby and humanoid_leggings below are vanilla's entries VERBATIM and must stay that way, exactly as our saddle.json leaves camels, pigs, striders and nautiluses alone. Only horse_body is ours. The three extra textures are derived from vanilla's leather_overlay.png by tools/tack/bake-leather-armor-textures.ps1: trim is the brown strapwork, fittings the metal bars, shadow the near-black depth that is deliberately NOT dyeable. color_when_undyed values are that script's output, and layer ORDER here is SaddleTint's LAYER_SEAT/BRIDLE/METAL - the two must not drift.
